# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text, k):
    """Return the ``k`` most common words in ``text``.

    Words are matched case-insensitively and defined as maximal runs of ASCII
    letters and apostrophes, so ``"don't"`` is one word while ``"well-known"``
    is two. Results are sorted by count descending, then alphabetically, and are
    returned as a list of ``(word, count)`` tuples in lowercase.
    """
    if k <= 0:
        return []
    counts = Counter(match.lower() for match in _WORD_RE.findall(text))
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]
